bluf: Adsmurai is a European growth and performance agency for enterprise clients that sells itself as a Growth-Tech Partner: proprietary software (the Adsmurai Marketing Platform, Kata, the new Adsmurai MCP, GEO Tracker) around paid social, paid search, SEO and GEO, and measurement. It is moving toward AI mediated media: the MCP is flagged NEW in the Sept 2026 menu and an OpenAI Ads offer is live. Horus reads it Favored at +22, best placed for KJ1. A rival should know it sells AI visibility and paid social while its own site publishes no llms.txt and runs no social ad pixel, and its client book holds one name, Desigual.
doing:
The positioning line, a Growth-Tech Partner combining proprietary technology, AI, data and expert teams into one scalable marketing system, means Adsmurai wants to be bought as software with a services team attached, not as a media agency. The headline claim, Greatest Impact at the TikTok Ad Awards 2025 for Desigual's Not a Doll campaign, comes from its own LinkedIn ad, so a creative award stands in for performance proof.

The menu runs from Digital Strategies and Consulting through Paid Social, SEM & PPC, Retail Media, Programmatic Advertising and SEO & GEO to Web Development & UX/UI and GA4 & Advanced Analytics. Two lines lead at score 3: Data & Measurement (the H1 leads with data; One Tag, dashboards and marketing mix modelling are offered) and AI Automation / Agents (Kata and the new MCP top the technology menu). AI Search / GEO, Paid Search, Paid Social and SEO score 2: GEO Tracker and an AI Overviews ebook; SEM & PPC in a paid media hub with a Campaign Management product; Paid Social with TikTok Creative Exchange as the only partner the record lists; an SEO & GEO page in three languages.

The AI posture is the whole pitch: Kata automates execution, the MCP connects AI tools to marketing data and workflows, GEO Tracker measures brand visibility in AI answers, and an OpenAI Ads offer prepares brands for advertising inside AI environments. Moves in order: the TikTok Ad Awards 2025 win; the MCP launch, flagged NEW in the Sept 2026 menu but undated; the OpenAI Ads offer, also undated. The record holds no news items, case studies or job postings.

Pricing: free tools (measurement, feeds, campaigns) work as lead magnets and no prices are shown; Horus scores P5 unknown. Conspicuously absent: no HQ city, founding year, headcount, ownership or offices in the record, no case study describing client work, and no platform partner beyond TikTok Creative Exchange.
clients:
The record describes an enterprise client profile, one vertical, Fashion & retail, and a European base with no HQ city listed. The site runs in English, Spanish and Italian with about 1,400 URLs and 410 blog posts, and the LinkedIn ads run in English and Italian, the nearest thing to home markets.

One client is named, Desigual, on an award entry: the TikTok Ad Awards 2025 Greatest Impact win for the Not a Doll campaign, surfaced through the LinkedIn ad library search. The needs read codes it N1, organic demand. That is a computed read; the signal, a TikTok campaign award, describes paid social creative work, so a strategist should hold the observed fact above the coded need. The book counts 1 client on record, 1 observed and 0 named only, and shared_n is 0: no client here sits on another tracked agency's book. The case studies page is a listed source, yet the record holds no case studies.

What the base needs next is a judgment on one name. Read against KJ1 (the click is being replaced by the citation) and KJ2 (ads inside AI answers scale faster than any channel before them, but the price and the proof are still unsettled), a fashion and retail advertiser that bought an awarded TikTok campaign is likely, at moderate confidence, to ask next for AI answer visibility and a tested position inside assistant ads, where Adsmurai has pointed GEO Tracker and its OpenAI Ads offer. KJ5 (the price of attention splits in two) is the risk: the paid social hours the award celebrates are the hours that judgment removes, so the same client has a roughly even chance of moving spend toward measured, first party fed media. The record is silent on retention and on any second client.
house:
Say and do: the AI Search / GEO line is contradicted (sells AI visibility, publishes no llms.txt, 36 AI-topic URLs in its sitemap); paid social is contradicted (no social ad pixel on its own site); paid search is unknown (Transparency Center lookup blocked); LinkedIn advertising is corroborated by 12 live ads; publishing cadence is corroborated, 14 of 1387 sitemap URLs updated in 90 days and 103 in 365. Horus counts 2 of 4 tested lines practised, integrity 50; the two flagged gaps are those misses.

The stack is HubSpot CMS with gtm and cookiebot tags; no test tools, ABM stack or social pixels are detected, and no AI crawlers are blocked. Google ad presence is unread (status blocked). LinkedIn shows 12 company page ads and 0 thought leader ads, mostly document ads in English and Italian; one reads "The UK's Peak Season is no longer a weekend". The record holds no Meta or TikTok ad library reading.

The work would go 50% to South and Southeast Asia and 40% to Eastern Europe; the footprint is inferred, with no hub offices or onshore claims listed.
openings:
Lead with the say/do gap on the lines it sells hardest. Adsmurai sells AI visibility through GEO Tracker and 36 AI-topic URLs and publishes no llms.txt; it sells paid social on the back of a TikTok award and runs no social ad pixel on its own site. A rival that arrives with its own llms.txt, its own pixel data and an audited citation share number is very likely, at high confidence, to make the system pitch read as a menu of unpractised lines. The falsifier: a fresh crawl of adsmurai.com showing llms.txt published and a social pixel firing.

The contestable client is the only one named, Desigual, whose evidence is a creative award on the paid social line Horus reads as most exposed to KJ5; an offer built on measurement and first party inputs rather than creative volume is likely, at moderate confidence, to get a hearing. Pricing is the undercut: free tools as lead magnets, no prices shown, P5 unknown, so a transparent, outcome priced offer is a conversation Adsmurai cannot have in public. On the Monsoon read (displacement 44.4) a pure offshore rate attack is unlikely to move this book; the argument is proof, not rate.
watch: I2, Alphabet Q3 2026 search growth and AI Mode ad disclosures, reads next in late October 2026: search and other growth below 10% flags cannibalization, and growth above 15% with AI Mode ads live confirms S1 and strengthens the KJ1 tailwind Adsmurai is placed for.
I10, Reddit US daily users against search referral volatility, reads next in late October 2026: US DAUq growth at or below 5% alongside AI Mode growth confirms the UGC starvation risk under KJ1.

I3, OpenAI ad run rate disclosures and CPM trend, is a rolling indicator: the next milestone ($2B) and its timing, and pricing below $20 CPM signalling supply outrunning demand, test the OpenAI Ads offer Adsmurai has put on its menu.
I7, Holiday 2026 agentic checkout volume and merchant opt out rates, reads December 2026 to January 2027: any disclosed AI checkout GMV moves KJ4, and high Shopify opt out rates would slow it.
Follow up the two undated launches, the Adsmurai MCP flagged NEW in the Sept 2026 menu and the OpenAI Ads offer, for a date, a price or a named client.
